name: Spurlock Custom Woodworks
old_description: At Spurlock Custom Woodworks LLC, we specialize in designing and building custom, made-to-order furniture that perfectly fits your style and space. Discover the beauty of handcrafted pieces made from premium hardwoods like Walnut, Oak, and Cherry.
about:
Spurlock Custom Woodworks LLC operates from a workshop on Morrison Road in Little Rock, Arkansas. The company designs and builds custom, made-to-order furniture for residential clients, focusing on premium hardwoods such as walnut, oak, and cherry. The business is organized as a limited liability company, though no founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces bedroom suites including bed frames, dressers, and nightstands, as well as bespoke cabinetry and living room pieces. Each item is handcrafted using traditional woodworking methods, with an emphasis on precision joinery and durable finishes. The company does not publish facility size, employee count, or annual volume metrics.

The business serves homeowners and interior designers seeking one-of-a-kind furnishings tailored to specific spaces. Customers submit design requests through an online form, and the company collaborates directly on dimensions, wood selection, and style details. Projects range from single accent pieces to whole-room installations.

Spurlock Custom Woodworks states that its differentiation lies in a commitment to superior craftsmanship, functionality, and timeless design, using only premium hardwoods and building each piece with precision and care to create heirloom-quality furniture that clients will cherish for years.
